tools.name: mcp__binance__analysis_getTokenAiReport
tools.description:
Get Token AI Report
Query the AI-generated report for a single token.

Returns a structured report (report metadata, token metadata, and
content modules) for the given token. 

Minimal request: send only `token`. When `timestamp` is omitted the
latest available report is returned; when `product` is omitted it
defaults to `spot`. `expId` may be omitted.

Notes:
- Single-token query only; batch is not supported.
- Not strictly real-time — suitable for research, summarization, Q&A,
  and attribution rather than live market data.

expId.description: Optional. Experiment id; may be omitted, empty string, or null.

product.description: Optional. Product domain of the report. Recommended to omit — defaults to `spot`. Currently `spot` is the documented value.

timestamp.description: Optional. Millisecond timestamp; returns the report closest to this time. Recommended to omit — when absent the latest report is returned.

token.description: Token symbol to query. The only required field.

tools.name: mcp__binance__convert_placeLimitOrder
tools.description:
Place limit order (TRADE)
Enable users to place a limit order

Notes:
- `baseAsset` and `quoteAsset` can be determined via the `exchangeInfo` endpoint.
- Limit price is defined from `baseAsset` to `quoteAsset`.
- Exactly one of `baseAmount` or `quoteAmount` should be sent.

baseAmount.description: Base asset amount. (One of `baseAmount` or `quoteAmount` is required)

baseAsset.description: base asset (use the response `fromIsBase` from `GET /sapi/v1/convert/exchangeInfo` api to check which one is baseAsset )

limitPrice.description: Symbol limit price (from baseAsset to quoteAsset)

quoteAmount.description: Quote asset amount. (One of `baseAmount` or `quoteAmount` is required)

walletType.description: Wallet to use for payment. Supported values: `SPOT`, `FUNDING`, `EARN`. Combined wallets also supported: `SPOT_FUNDING`, `FUNDING_EARN`, `SPOT_FUNDING_EARN`, `SPOT_EARN`. Default is `SPOT`.

tools.name: mcp__binance__convert_sendQuoteRequest
tools.description:
Send Quote Request (TRADE)
Request a quote for the requested token pairs

Notes:
- Either `fromAmount` or `toAmount` should be sent.
- `quoteId` is returned only if you have enough funds to convert.

fromAmount.description: When specified, it is the amount you will be debited after the conversion

toAmount.description: When specified, it is the amount you will be credited after the conversion

validTime.description: Quote valid duration. Supported values: 10s, 30s, 1m. Default is 10s.

walletType.description: Wallet to use for payment. Supported values: `SPOT`, `FUNDING`, `EARN`. Combined wallets also supported.
